issues.description: RollerCoaster constructor parameter type does not match the UML/problem statement. The UML specifies attribute `numberOfLoopings: int` and requires constructors to take attributes in the UML-defined types/order, but the solution declares `public RollerCoaster(String name, char abbreviation, double numberOfLoopings)` and casts the value to int. This contradicts the stated constructor signature expectations and can mislead students about the required parameter type.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the RollerCoaster constructor signature to `public RollerCoaster(String name, char abbreviation, int numberOfLoopings)` and assign directly (`this.numberOfLoopings = numberOfLoopings;`). Keep subclass constructor calls consistent (e.g., `LaunchedRollerCoaster` should continue passing an `int`).
